component.name: KnightSight
component.summary: Show your coding assistant one window, only that one

description.p: KnightSight shares one window or one region of the screen with a coding assistant that speaks MCP. The assistant can look at it, click in it and type into it. It sees nothing outside the share, and nothing at all until it asks.

ul.li: Pick a window or drag a rectangle, then start sharing when you are ready
Refuses every click and key outside the share, and the Super key everywhere
Shows what is going on, such as "Typing" or "Taking a screenshot"
Ctrl+Alt+Shift+X or closing the window ends the share at once
Reachable from another machine through one SSH tunnel

description.p: On Wayland the desktop asks which window or screen to share, and the desktop moves the real pointer for each click. On X11 a click brings the window to the front for a moment, then your window and pointer go back to where they were.

screenshot.caption: A chosen window in a grey frame, not shared yet
A shared window in a yellow frame

description.p: KnightSight comes to Linux and macOS, with the same MCP server for every system.
The first release of KnightSight: one window or one screen region, shared with a coding assistant and nothing else.
